environment.caveat: The ranges set oxygen, pressure and flow only. Matched tests can have carbon dioxide or helium added to the atmosphere; each need block gives the number.

need.question: Under what conditions does the flame go out: lower oxygen or pressure, added inert gas, or reduced flow?
need.reading: A counted test records the fuel, the oxygen and how the burn ended or an event word. Its pressure is a value of the table (FLEX) or, for BASS-II, a statement of the investigators about the investigation as a whole (ICES19.pressure), not a reading per test. In the FLEX table the ending is extinction, disruption or completion: the count is not a count of extinctions, and 'extinction' is also the recorded end of FLEX tests with no carbon dioxide and no helium added. The indicator 'S1.test_end' gives the count per ending.

top_line.text: Not judged here. 56 of the 298 tests counted for this need were recorded with oxygen and pressure both inside the ranges of this environment; 7 more with oxygen inside the range and no pressure in the table, and 0 more with pressure inside the range and no oxygen in the table. sentences.text: 56 of the 298 tests counted for this need were recorded with oxygen and pressure both inside the ranges of this environment.

The 298 counted tests by match with this environment: 56 with oxygen and pressure both inside the ranges; 7 with oxygen inside the range and no pressure in the table; 0 with pressure inside the range and no oxygen in the table; 235 with none of these matches.
The 63 matched tests come from PSI-25, PSI-69.
The 63 matched tests by fuel phase: liquid 56, solid 7.
Oxygen of the 63 matched tests: recorded in 63, from 19 to 21 % by volume.
Pressure of the 63 matched tests: recorded in 56, from 100.4451 to 102.8449 kPa.
27 of the 63 tests with oxygen inside the range and pressure inside the range or not in the table have carbon dioxide or helium added to the atmosphere.
Flow speed of the 63 tests with oxygen inside the range and pressure inside the range or not in the table: inside the flow range of this environment in 7 tests; not recorded in 56 tests.
Gravity level of the 63 tests with oxygen inside the range and pressure inside the range or not in the table: recorded as microgravity, the level of this environment, in 63 tests.

The experimental table of PSI-25 holds no pressure. A NASA record or a paper of the investigators says: "Pressure was not varied from 1 atmosphere." (source: ICES19.pressure). The sentence is not used as a value of any test.

sentences.text: This environment covers 1 cell of the coverage grid (oxygen bin by pressure bin). Of the 4 cells one step away in oxygen or in pressure, 4 hold a counted test of this need matched by oxygen, by pressure or by both.
A test at a neighbouring condition is not evidence for this condition.

A test with oxygen in the table and no pressure is counted in every pressure bin of its oxygen bin, and a test with pressure and no oxygen in every oxygen bin of its pressure bin. The same test is therefore in more than one cell, and in a cell that shares a bin with this environment it can be a test already listed at the condition; each cell gives that number. Counts of cells are not to be added.
